additional_events.detail: The first Compress-Archive call used -LiteralPath with a wildcard and rejected the path before creating an archive. A corrected -Path invocation then created the preserved 564261-byte archive; no scientific process or evidence payload was altered.

The initial manifest serialization referenced its executable path before assignment; a first replacement then emitted a non-escaped JSON path. Both defects were caught before publication and corrected; the final manifest parses and names the pinned Godot executable. No scientific process changed or repeated.
